rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides natural language to SQL query generation for legal case management systems, enabling users to ask questions like 'show me my high-priority open cases' and automatically converting them to safe, validated SQL queries. Features comprehensive query validation with safety checks that block data modification attempts, enforce WHERE clauses on large tables, and restrict access to only authorized tables. Includes detailed business glossary and query pattern documentation to help translate business terminology into proper database filters, with automatic status value normalization to handle case sensitivity issues.
